text:
Claire H: Draft uploaded (doc link in thread). Need quick checks: 1) final headline, 2) benchmark box wording + test conditions, 3) webinar CTA and inbound routing. Hoping to lock by COB.

Marco L: Headline option: 'From prototype to product: predictable inference for engineering teams' 1 shorter alt: 'Predictable inference, predictable velocity'.

Sofia T: Love Marco's alt. Product asks we call out 'rollouts: pin versions, canary rollbacks' in the hero (one sentence). Also add a tiny two-line comparison: Hosted vs Dedicated (focus: speed vs compliance).

Dan R: Benchmarks  avoid marketing multipliers. Propose a callout: "median generation 205ms, p95 460ms at 1k tokens (NVIDIA A100s, batch=8, FP16)" and link to reproducibility notes. Add hardware + batch so it's reproducible.

Priya S: Legal: cannot use absolutes re: data. Replace "we never access customer prompts" with "customers may opt for dedicated deployments or VPC peering for data residency and isolation." Also require the eval PDF uploaded to /legal/audit with checksum before publish.

Claire H: will swap residency language, add the rollout sentence, and place Dan's benchmark numbers in a boxed callout. I'll upload the eval now.

Ops-Alex: Ops rec: publish Tuesday 10:00am PT; webinar 48 hours later at 11:00am PT so partners have time. HubSpot form created: https://hubspot.forms/launch-3398. Hidden fields: campaign=prod_launch_q2_2026, channel=blog. Add checkbox: 'send_eval' to trigger workflow.

Marco L: CTA copy: 'Register for the launch webinar to see a live demo and request the technical eval.' Keep primary CTA -> blog inline form, secondary -> webinar sign-up.

Priya S: legal will approve when eval PDF is in the audit folder and the compliance checklist is attached. Also recommend the phrase "data residency and isolation" rather than "data isolation".

Claire H: uploaded eval: /legal/audit/3398765432_eval.pdf (sha256: abc123...placeholder). Updated residency phrasing to Priya's suggestion. Inserted CTO quote: "Operational predictability is how teams ship." 1 attributed to Amir.

Dan R: product sign-off on benchmark wording. Small nit: hero image alt should read 'Redwood Inference dashboard'.

Ops-Alex: HubSpot mapping: list 'Q2_Launch_2026', tags ['source:blog','interest:eval'], hidden fields as above. Workflow: if send_eval=true then email S3 link and add lead to nurture sequence. Test form URL posted in thread.

Claire H: great 1 final signoffs from product, legal, ops. @publish-bot can you schedule CMS publish for 2026-09-14T10:00:00-07:00 and wire the HubSpot webhook to the form?

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post 'From prototype to product: predictable inference for engineering teams' set to publish 2026-09-14 10:00 PDT. HubSpot webhook configured; eval workflow active.

Claire H: thanks all. Final checklist: headline locked, benchmark callout + eval attached, legal ok, HubSpot mapping live. Will press publish on Tuesday unless anyone objects. :rocket:
